description: Show products from the owner's Shopify store on their page: photo, title, price, sale price and stock, refreshed every hour. Taps go to the product on their store, where people check out. Pass the store's address and up to 12 products (product links or handles), or none to show the newest. Change them later with update_block shopProducts, rowTitle and postsLayout ("grid" or "carousel").

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

products.description: Product links or handles, in the order to show them. Leave out to show the newest products.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

title.description: Shown above the products, such as "Shop".

url.description: The store's address, like mystore.com or mystore.myshopify.com.

name: add_shop
title: Add Shopify products
